workflow.task_summary: Normalize the uploaded public-repository metadata TSV into a FASTQ sample-sheet CSV, preserving sample/run identifiers, single/paired layout, predicted FASTQ paths, and organism metadata without validating read files.

steps.reason: The only available input is the depository metadata TSV, and the registered sample_sheet_prepare skill is designed to normalize SRA RunInfo/sequencing metadata into a FASTQ sample sheet, producing a CSV with the requested identifiers, layout, FASTQ paths, and organism metadata.
